data.title: UN climate disaster fund moves to provide $20m aid for Nepal
data.description: WASHINGTON - The United Nations' (UN) climate loss and damage fund moved Thursday to provide US$20 million in aid sought by flood-stricken Nepal, the first time it has set aside money for any country, in a key test of the body's credibility.

data.title: Pentagon, Lockheed announce agreement for 850 F-35 jets over 10 years
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The Pentagon and Lockheed Martin on Thursday announced a 10-year agreement for the production of 850 F-35 warplanes, underscoring Washington's long-term commitment to the high-tech stealth aircraft.

data.title: American detained in Russia arrives in US: lawyer
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - A retired US teacher freed by President Vladimir Putin after four years' detention in Russia for allegedly fighting on behalf of Ukraine has returned to the United States, his lawyer said Thursday.

data.title: French authorities seek to ban or curb fresh protests
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - French authorities on Thursday imposed bans and restrictions aimed at fresh protests springing up in the wake of demonstrations last weekend that degenerated into the worst street violence in years.

data.title: 'Solution from the heavens': Indonesians pray for rain as fires burn
data.description: SURABAYA (INDONESIA) - Indonesian schoolchildren prayed for rain on Thursday as another firefighter lost his life battling drought-fuelled blazes consuming forests and peatlands and blanketing parts of Southeast Asia in a sickening haze.

data.title: Nearly all coral reefs risk collapse in 50 years: IUCN
data.description: YEREVAN - Nearly all of the world's shallow-water coral reefs face an "extremely high risk" of collapse by 2075 due to climate change, the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) warned Thursday.

data.title: Targeted by Trump, ICC awarded top EU rights prize
data.description: STRASBOURG, France - Facing US sanctions, the International Criminal Court on Thursday was awarded the European Union’s top rights prize, in a show of support that risks upsetting President Donald Trump.

data.title: Son of Aung San Suu Kyi gets first phone call in five years
data.description: YANGON - The son of Aung San Suu Kyi said he spoke on Thursday to the detained former democratic leader of Myanmar for the first time in more than five years.

data.title: China slams ‘Cold War mentality’ in EU Arctic plan
data.description: BEIJING - China says it opposes “using Cold War mentality” to stoke conflict over the Arctic, after the European Union linked Beijing’s cooperation with Russia in the region to security concerns.

data.title: Targeted by Trump, ICC in running for top EU rights prize
data.description: STRASBOURG — Facing US sanctions, the International Criminal Court is up for the European Union's top rights prize Thursday, with supporters pressing its case as a show of support for a fraying rules-based world order.

data.title: Lula seeks tit-for-tat annulment of Bolsonaro election candidacy
data.description: BRASíLIA - Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's campaign requested the disqualification of right-wing rival Flavio Bolsonaro from the presidential race on Wednesday, a day after his opponent did the same.

data.title: Focus turns to businesses as Indonesia fire haze worsens
data.description: After months of fires in Indonesia that have caused thick regional haze, attention is turning to whether companies can be held accountable for the blazes and resulting air pollution.

data.title: Seoul sees no signs of new North Korean weapons on border
data.description: SEOUL - South Korea's military said on Thursday it had seen no signs of newly deployed North Korean weapons on their shared border, hours after Pyongyang said new "counter means" would be put on alert along its length.

data.title: Washington’s $14bn arms sale to Taiwan stalls
data.description: TAIPEI - Taiwan has been waiting months for US President Donald Trump to approve a $14 billion sale of weapons and equipment, which the island democracy would use to fend off a potential Chinese attack.

data.title: US orders embassy staff, families to leave Saudi Arabia
data.description: RIYADH - Washington has ordered non-essential US embassy staff and their families to leave Saudi Arabia, the State Department said on Wednesday, as the kingdom comes under sustained deadly attacks by Yemen’s Houthis.

data.title: New rescue bid as ‘celebrity shark’ returns to Busan canal
data.description: SEOUL - A shark that became a viral sensation after getting stuck in a South Korean canal returned hours after being coaxed out, authorities said on Thursday, prompting another attempt to guide it back to the sea.

data.title: Trump faces fresh questions over ties to 'humanitarian' Putin
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US President Donald Trump's pivot away from Ukraine has triggered fresh questions about his attachment to Russian leader Vladimir Putin, the man a top American envoy flattered on Wednesday as a "humanitarian."

data.title: Musk threatens Democrats teeing up congressional probes
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - Elon Musk, President Donald Trump's multi-billionaire ally, on Wednesday threatened Democrats who want to investigate alleged corruption and his role in the US government if they win control of Congress next month.

data.title: Quebec separatist premier sworn in without royal presence
data.description: MONTREAL (CANADA) - Quebec's new separatist leader took office Wednesday after being sworn in without pledging an oath to King Charles III, while the monarch's official representative in the Canadian province stayed away from the ceremony.

data.title: Washington orders US embassy staff, families to leave Saudi Arabia
data.description: RIYADH (SAUDI ARABIA) - Washington has ordered non-essential US embassy staff and their families to leave Saudi Arabia, the State Department said on Wednesday, as the kingdom comes under sustained deadly attacks by Yemen's Houthis.

data.title: Judge orders Meta to pay $25 bn to New Mexico in Cambridge Analytica case
data.description: SAN FRANCISCO (UNITED STATES) - A New Mexico judge ruled Wednesday that Meta must pay $25 billion to the state after a jury found last month that the social media giant had deceived users in a case related to the Cambridge Analytica scandal, according to media reports.

data.title: Maradona doctor was made 'scapegoat' for his death, Argentine court told
data.description: SAN ISIDRO (ARGENTINA) - A lawyer for Leopoldo Luque, a doctor charged in the 2020 death of Argentine football legend Diego Maradona, said in closing arguments Wednesday that his client was innocent and had been made a "scapegoat."

data.title: UN says El Nino indicators already ‘off the charts’
data.description: GENEVA - The El Nino weather phenomenon gripping the planet is heading off the charts, the United Nations warned on Wednesday, saying countries should take urgent action to prepare for the worst.

data.title: Rightists worldwide blame immigrants for French crisis
data.description: PARIS - Right-wing politicians around the world have seized on France’s riots, casting immigration as the culprit ahead of tense elections testing their own populist credentials.

data.title: Visiting Argentine president calls Spanish PM a ‘dictator’
data.description: MADRID - Argentina’s far-right President Javier Milei called Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez a “dictator” in a visit to Madrid on Wednesday, urging voters to oust the Socialist leader in upcoming elections.
